title: The Month-End Lot
brief: It is the last day of the month at Meridian Microworks. Lot L-9002 must ship tonight to meet the month-end target and a customer order. It has an open discrepancy: 3 wafers measured just above the thickness limit. The production manager proposes shipping and "dealing with it next month". You have 12 visit points to decide.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: Thickness data: 3 of 25 wafers in L-9002 read 0.2 to 0.5 micrometers above the upper limit on gauge TG-1.
evidence.whyItMatters: Nonconforming output must be identified and controlled.

evidence.text: Metrologist: "TG-1 was calibrated last week and repeats within 0.05." Record confirms.
Production manager: "Month-end numbers matter more than 3 wafers. Ship it." (note 2)
evidence.whyItMatters: Leadership must support the system; targets must not override release controls.

evidence.text: Production manager: "Quality manager approves deviations; she is on site."
Material review procedure MR-2 allows segregation of nonconforming wafers and release of the rest after review.
Customer terms DV-3 require written approval to ship any wafer outside limits.
Customer due date is 3 days from now; tonight's shipment is for the month-end target, not the customer date.
evidence.whyItMatters: The customer is not harmed by a short delay.

evidence.text: Lot status L-9002 shows "released" in the system with the discrepancy open.
evidence.whyItMatters: Status must reflect the open nonconformity.
evidence.missedExplanation: Check system status against the facts.

evidence.text: Month-end target chart shows 96 percent of target.
Sort technician: "I can pull the 3 wafers in 20 minutes."
Packing materials are standard and in stock.

options: Set the lot to hold, remove the 3 wafers under MR-2, have the quality manager review and release the 22 conforming wafers tonight, and ask the customer about the 3 if needed
Hold the whole lot until next month
decisions.rationale: Segregation lets conforming wafers ship on time while respecting the customer's terms.
optionFeedback: Ships known nonconforming wafers without approval.
Proportionate and uses the defined route.

decisions.prompt: How do you respond to "month-end numbers matter more"?
options: Acknowledge the target and show that the 22 wafers can still count tonight through the defined route
Escalate a complaint about the manager
decisions.rationale: Address the pressure with a route that meets both needs.

containment: Set L-9002 to hold and segregate the 3 wafers
correction: Release 22 conforming wafers after review; disposition the 3 as authorized
cause: The system allows release with an open discrepancy
corrective: Block release while discrepancies are open
effectiveness: Audit releases at the next three month-ends

debriefText.found: You found a route that ships conforming wafers on time.
debriefText.missed: Ask whose deadline it really is.
